meta_title: Install VpnHood! CONNECT on Linux | VpnHood!
meta_description: Install VpnHood! CONNECT on Linux with one command, sign in to your Premium account, and connect from its window or the command line.
title: Install VpnHood! CONNECT on Linux
lead: One command installs the app, with its window and a set of commands. Sign in once from either, then connect from either, with or without a desktop.
before_need: A Premium plan, as the Linux version does not have any free servers: upgrade to Premium.
connect_desktop: Open [app] from the application menu, sign in to your Premium account and connect.
connect_terminal: From a terminal, or on a machine with no desktop, sign in, connect, and check the connection:
connect_note: [cmd] sign-in asks for your password. With a premium code instead of an account, run [cmd] premium-code and the code in its place.
cmd_sign_in: Signs in to your account. It asks for your password, or reads it from standard input.
cmd_premium_code: Sets the premium code the app connects with. [premium_remove] takes it off.
